description: This file defines the OpenmrsSerializer interface which specifies methods for serializing and deserializing objects within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: OpenmrsSerializer
classes.description: Interface for serialization implementations in the OpenMRS platform, providing methods for serializing objects to strings and deserializing strings back into objects.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts an object into a string that can be stored or transmitted, throwing SerializationException on failure.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Reconstructs an object from a serialized string, given the class type, throwing SerializationException on failure.
